episodes.title: Not a Cult (Probably): True Crime, Reality TV & Amye Archer
episodes.description: This week we're joined by podcaster, author, and true crime aficionado Amye Archer of Little Miss Recap and Murder She Watched! We dive into the fascinating overlap between true crime and reality TV, debate whether armchair detectives help or hurt investigations, and swap our all-time favorite documentaries (and comfort rewatches). From Making a Murderer, Tiger King, and The Staircase to Sister Wives, 90 Day Fiancé, Welcome to Plathville, and Love Island, no topic is off-limits. We also talk cults, body image, Gen X nostalgia, documentaries that should've been an email, and why anyone insisting they're "not running a cult" probably deserves a second look. Grab a cocktail and join us for one of our most fun conversations yet!

episodes.title: Cults & Couture: Ahmadi Religion of Peace and Light, Church of God with Signs Following & RHOSLC
episodes.description:
This week, we’re diving into two wild corners of the cult world: the modern, media-savvy Ahmadi Religion of Peace and Light and the snake-handling, strychnine-drinking Church of God with Signs Following. From international recruitment tactics to Appalachian backroads, these stories are as unsettling as they are fascinating.
And of course—we’re breaking down all the latest drama from The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City. Buckle up for cults, chaos, and cold Utah shade.
